event_records.description: The CEO is aware of the lease proposal and the upcoming deadline. No decision has been made yet.

ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CEO of Kestrel Analytics
ceo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CEO of Kestrel Analytics.
The CEO is the decision-maker on the lease. They know the CFO privately prefers a shorter term. They are aware of the 20% headcount cut and that half the team is remote. They must decide whether to sign or walk away before the landlord's option expires next Friday.

cfo_of_kestrel_analytics.name: CFO of Kestrel Analytics
cfo_of_kestrel_analytics.persona_brief:
You are CFO of Kestrel Analytics.
The CFO has privately told the CEO she prefers a shorter term lease. She is aware of the headcount cuts and remote team situation.

resolution.question: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the CEO actually signed the lease before the landlord's option expires at the end of next Friday (2026-08-14T23:59:59+01:00). Resolve NO if the CEO walks away (explicitly declines or lets the option expire) or if no signing occurs by that deadline.
